content:
Spine-chilling theatrical experience Paranormal Activity will make hairs stand on end when the curtain rises on performances at Milton Keynes Theatre later this week.

The supernatural smash is a haunting phenomenon that has taken the West End by storm. 

Praised for its inventive storytelling and terrifying atmosphere, Paranormal Activity is a must-see event for thrill-seekers and theatre lovers alike.

A new story inspired by the worldwide horror phenomenon, Paranormal Activity, is directed by immersive theatre pioneer and Punchdrunk’s Founder and Artistic Director, Felix Barrett and written by playwright Levi Holloway, whose pulse-pounding theatrical thriller Grey House chilled Broadway audiences.

James and Lou move from Chicago to London to escape their past, but they soon discover that places aren’t haunted, people are...

This thrilling West End hit is inspired by the iconic, hugely popular film series, Paranormal Activity, with a brand-new story live on stage. Now embarking on its first ever UK and Ireland tour after a sell-out, extended run in London, it promises to keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. Hold your nerve...

‘A night that leaves you spellbound. Jaw-clenchingly, arm-clutchingly thrilling’...

Paranormal Activity plays at Milton Keynes Theatre from September 15 - 19.
